What you'll work on
We're hiring a firmware engineer to own the embedded software stack on our wearable capture hardware. Close-to-the-metal work at the intersection of high-bandwidth sensor data, precise timing, and constrained-power embedded compute. You read schematics, debug buses, and know when the bug is in firmware versus when it's in hardware.

System architecture

  • Firmware architecture on embedded Linux on ARM

  • System state machines: boot, capture, idle, fault recovery

  • Power management states and low-power transitions

Sensor integration and timing

  • Drivers for cameras, IMUs, microphones, environmental sensors

  • Sub-millisecond cross-sensor synchronization

  • Hardware-level timestamping infrastructure

  • Real-time sensor data alignment

  • Lightweight on-device fusion for orientation and worn-state estimation (Kalman variants)

Data pipeline

  • Multi-stream concurrent capture

  • Hardware video encoder pipelines

  • High-throughput storage writes

  • Industry-standard delivery format packing

Connectivity and fleet operations

  • Device-to-backend telemetry (battery, storage, session state, error events)

  • Secure OTA firmware updates with signed images and rollback protection

  • Remote configuration and fleet management commands

  • Communication protocols for device-cloud messaging (MQTT-over-TLS, HTTPS, WebSockets)

Hardware / software bring-up

  • Firmware-side board bring-up alongside electrical engineers

  • Validate hardware interfaces (I²C, SPI, USB, MIPI)

  • Diagnose timing, power sequencing, and communication faults

Required technical experience

  • Strong C/C++ for embedded systems on ARM

  • Python for testing, tooling, and automation

  • Camera driver experience (V4L2 or equivalent)

  • Deep familiarity with embedded interfaces: MIPI CSI-2, I²C, SPI, USB, interrupts

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets

Systems and concurrency

  • Interrupts, race conditions, memory constraints, real-time scheduling

  • RTOS concepts and multi-threaded embedded environments

Strong plus

  • Qualcomm, NXP, or Ambarella BSP experience

  • SerDes driver integration

  • Hardware H.264 / H.265 encoder pipelines

  • Precise timing and synchronization (PTP, IEEE 1588)

  • High-bandwidth data acquisition

  • Sensor fusion and Kalman filter implementation

  • OTA infrastructure for deployed fleets

  • IoT telemetry stacks (MQTT, AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or similar)

  • ROS, MCAP, or Foxglove

About this role Deep systems work. Long hours in the lab during board bring-up. Drivers nobody has written for the silicon you're working with. Firmware that runs unattended on real users for full shifts — and gets updated remotely without ever recalling a device.

jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Human Archive runs large-scale field deployments to collect egocentric robotics data. We are hiring a Deployment Associate to be our person on the ground at every site. You will be the site lead for your deployment - setting up and running the capture devices, building and maintaining the task taxonomy that defines what gets collected, supervising the workers performing the tasks, and making sure every hour of data that leaves the site is clean, complete, and correctly labelled. This is the role that decides whether a deployment produces usable data or unusable data. It is hands-on, detail-heavy, and best suited to someone who is equally comfortable talking to workers on a shop floor and enforcing a strict data protocol. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own the taxonomy - Build and maintain the task and activity taxonomy for each deployment - the breakdown of tasks, sub-tasks, objects, and environments being captured - Study the site's real workflows and translate them into a clear, consistent, collectable structure - Keep naming conventions, labels, and category definitions consistent across sites, days, and operators - Flag gaps, overlaps, and ambiguous categories, and refine the taxonomy as new environments are onboarded Run the site - Act as site lead for the deployment - first point of contact for the client site, the workers, and the internal team - Brief workers on what is being captured, how, and why, and keep them productive through the day - Supervise, correct, and re-train operators in real time so capture quality does not drift - Track daily targets - hours captured, tasks covered, sessions completed - and report progress Deploy the hardware - Set up, fit, calibrate, and troubleshoot capture devices (head-mounted cameras, sensors, recorders, batteries, storage) - Manage charging, storage cards, device assignment, and end-of-day teardown - Diagnose and resolve device failures on the spot; escalate and swap when they cannot be fixed - Maintain accurate device, accessory, and inventory records for dispatch and return Own the data - Run data collection end to end - capture, offload, verification, backup, and upload - Check every session before it leaves the site: correct framing, complete recordings, no corrupt or missing files, correct metadata - Maintain session logs mapping every file to task, worker, device, location, and timestamp Follow and improve SOPs - Execute deployment SOPs exactly - setup checklists, consent and safety protocols, capture standards, upload procedures - Enforce compliance across the whole site team, not just yourself - Document what breaks in the field and turn it into better SOPs, checklists, and training material - Help train new associates and team leads as we scale to more sites and cities WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - 1–4 years of experience in field operations (in companies like Swiggy, Zomato, Snabbit, Urban Company, Blinkit etc), data collection, production, QC, or a similar hands-on execution role. Someone who has managed the cluster or area and lead the team. - Genuinely detail-oriented - you notice a mislabelled folder, a wrong angle, or a missing file before anyone else does - Quite comfortable with travel as it can be hectic like - 1st week in Assam then next to Bihar, and 3rd can be in Chennai. - Comfortable with structure: checklists, naming conventions, logs, spreadsheets, and daily reporting - Practically minded with hardware - you can set up, debug, and maintain equipment without needing an engineer - Able to lead and direct a group of workers with respect and clarity, including people from very different backgrounds - Calm and decisive when a device dies, a worker doesn't show up, or a site changes plans mid-day - Willing to travel and be on-site full time, including in factories, warehouses, kitchens, workshops, and other working environments - High agency and high urgency - you take full ownership of your site's output Experience in field data collection, data operations or ground operations at companies like Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Urban Company, Delhivery, Amazon, or Flipkart is a strong advantage. You might have: - Led a major college fest, event, or student organization - Run a Formula Student / Formula Electric / robotics / aerospace team - Worked on biotech experiments, hardware projects, fabrication, carpentry, woodworking, civil engineering, bridge-building, or other hands-on engineering projects - Built a strong community of unusually ambitious students - Been the person who could actually make things happen inside your university WHAT YOU’LL DO You’ll work directly with the founders to build a pan-India network of high-quality student organizations. About the role

Human Archive (YC W26) is hiring someone to lead our end-to-end data annotation operations.

You will work directly with the founder to build and manage a high-performing annotator workforce for robotics data. Your job is to ensure we consistently have the right people, quality, and throughput across multiple projects running simultaneously.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is excellent with people, metrics, and fast-moving operations.

What you will do

  • Recruit, evaluate, and manage high-quality data annotators

  • Maintain a high bar for annotation quality and workforce performance

  • Allocate annotators across multiple simultaneous projects

  • Track daily throughput, quality, attendance, utilisation, and project targets

  • Build dashboards and operating systems with our engineering team

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve annotation workflows

  • Design incentives that help teams consistently meet daily targets

  • Forecast staffing requirements for upcoming projects

  • Manage team leads and resolve day-to-day operational issues

  • Build processes that can scale from hundreds to thousands of annotators

Who we are looking for

  • Extremely good with people and frontline teams

  • Strong analytical ability and comfort with metrics and dashboards

  • Excellent at prioritisation and resource allocation

  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple projects at once

  • Creative about incentives, hiring, performance, and operations

  • Clear, direct, and fast communicator

  • High ownership, energy, urgency, and agency

  • Comfortable working in a demanding, fast-changing startup environment

Experience at companies such as Surge AI, Scale AI, Mercor, Turing, Outlier, Remotasks, or similar workforce and data-operations businesses is a strong advantage.


Ideally 2+ YOE

Location

On-site in Bangalore.
